context_for_next_testing_agent: Technician SMS invitation feature fully tested. All CRUD operations work: POST /invite creates invitation with 6-digit code, GET /invites returns pending list, DELETE /invites/{id} cancels, POST /invites/{id}/resend extends expiration. Frontend dialog has SMS/Email tabs with proper field validation. Pending invites section shows with Resend (RefreshCw) and Cancel (Trash2) buttons. Note: Actual SMS sending via Twilio is disabled in test environment.
